story.headline: Werenski heads back to Danny
body: **Vin** (12th, 1-4) makes his 19th trade, his first ever with **Danny** (8th, 2-3).
**Danny** gets **Zach Werenski**, Vin's 6th-round pick and Danny's own 7th-rounder back in 2017-18, with 43.8 points since the deal.
**Vin** gets **Brayden McNabb**, Danny's 14th-rounder (21.7), and **Dylan Larkin**, a week-5 waiver claim by Danny who hasn't scored since the trade.

story.headline: The Fantrax era's first trade: Svechnikov to Danny
body: The first trade on Fantrax: **Danny** (3rd, 2-1) and **Tim** (5th, 2-1) meet for the third time.
**Tim** gets goalie **Stuart Skinner**, Danny's last-round pick (and his 6th-rounder in 2023-24), with 34.4 points so far.
**Danny** gets **Andrei Svechnikov**, Tim's 7th-round pick and Danny's own first-rounder in 2020-21, with 57.5 since the trade.

story.headline: Will's first trade sends Kaprizov to Vin
body: **Will** makes his first trade ever, and it's with the league's trade king. **Vin** is 4th at 9-7, Will 6th at 8-8.
**Vin** gets **Kirill Kaprizov**, Will's 3rd-round pick, and **Alexis Lafrenière** (9th round). Kaprizov didn't score for Vin after the trade; Lafrenière added 19.5. Vin finished 5th.
**Will** gets **Matt Boldy** (37) and **Bryan Rust** (5), Vin's 10th- and 17th-round picks. Will finished 10th.

story.headline: Barzal for Daccord as Danny and Tim meet again
body: **Danny** (7th, 9-8) and **Tim** (6th, 9-8) make their second trade, a year after their first.
**Tim** gets goalie **Joey Daccord**, a week-12 pickup by Danny, who scored 11.8. Tim finished 10th.
**Danny** gets **Mathew Barzal**, Tim's 9th-round pick, who scored 37.7. Danny finished 7th.

story.headline: Joe sends first-rounder Tkachuk to Vin in a three-for-three
body: **Vin** (8th, 1-3) and **Joe** (11th, 1-3) swap three players each in week 5. It's Vin's 17th trade.

**Vin** gets Joe's first-round pick **Matthew Tkachuk**, whom Vin had traded for in 2019-20 and drafted in 2022-23. He scored 212.3 for Vin, who finished 2nd. **Ilya Samsonov** and **Victor Olofsson** didn't score for him.
**Joe** gets **Lawson Crouse** (146.2), **Bryan Rust** (89.9) and goalie **Darcy Kuemper** (73.6), whom Joe had drafted the year before. Joe finished 12th.

story.headline: Tim's first trade comes at the deadline
body: **Tim** makes his first trade ever in week 20, sitting 3rd at 13-6. **Danny** (7th, 9-10) is the partner.
**Danny** gets **Alexis Lafrenière**, Tim's 9th-round pick, who never scored in Danny's lineup the rest of the way. Danny finished 6th.
**Tim** gets goalie **Joonas Korpisalo**, a week-19 pickup by Danny, and made a run to finish 2nd.

story.headline: Vin and Zac, trade No. 6: the league's busiest pair
body: **Vin** (4th, 8-4) and **Zac** (11th, 4-8) make their sixth trade together, a two-for-three, and no pair in the league has traded more.
**Vin** gets **Tom Wilson**, Zac's 6th-round pick and Vin's own 2nd-rounder the year before (114.9), and **John Klingberg** (44.6). Vin finished 2nd.
**Zac** gets goalie **Cam Talbot**, Vin's 13th-rounder (96.6), and two week-8 pickups, **Dmitry Orlov** (69.2) and **Michael Bunting** (51.4). Zac finished 8th.

story.headline: Boxing Day deal: Doughty to Vin
body: A Boxing Day trade: **Vin** (4th, 7-3) and **Tom** (9th, 3-7) do business for the second time.
**Vin** gets **Drew Doughty**, Tom's 9th-round pick (and Vin's own 4th-rounder in 2016-17). Doughty scored 89.8 for Vin, who finished 2nd.
**Tom** gets **Artem Zub** (91.3) and goalie **Alex Nedeljkovic** (57.8), both early-season pickups by Vin. Tom finished 11th.

story.headline: Taylor Hall, round two: the future champ brings him back
body: **Vin** (2nd, 4-1) and **Zac** (9th, 1-4) trade for the fifth time, and Vin goes back for a familiar winger.
**Vin** gets **Taylor Hall**, Zac's 5th-round pick, whom Vin had also traded for in November 2019. Hall scored 11.5 for Vin, who went on to win the 2020-21 title.
**Zac** gets **James van Riemsdyk**, a week-5 waiver claim by Vin, who scored 31.9. Zac finished 9th.

story.headline: The league's first and only three-team trade
body: Three days after the Stamkos deal, **Jefe** (2nd, 11-2) pulls off the league's first and only three-team trade, with **Zac** (8th, 6-7) and **Joe** (9th, 5-8).
**Jefe** gets **Casey Cizikas** (25.3) and **Dougie Hamilton** (1), both gone by mid-February.
**Zac** gets **Mark Stone**, who scored 70.1 for him.
**Joe** gets **Brady Tkachuk**, the big winner of the deal with 91.4.

story.headline: Stamkos to the defending champ
body: **Jefe**, the defending champion and 2nd at 11-2, lands a first-rounder from **Palagi** (6th, 7-6) in their second trade together.
**Jefe** gets **Steven Stamkos**, Palagi's first-round pick (a first-rounder in each of the league's first four seasons), who scored 98.9, plus 12th-rounder **Anders Lee** (47.7).
**Palagi** gets three players: **Jordan Staal** (19.2), Jefe's 4th-rounder **Tomas Hertl** (6.8) and **Jakob Chychrun** (3).

story.headline: Vin and Nick, deal No. 5: Matthew Tkachuk to Vin
body: **Vin** (6th, 7-5) and **Nick** (3rd, 7-5) make their fifth trade together, the most of any pair at the time.
**Nick** gets goalie **Mackenzie Blackwood**, a week-6 pickup by Vin (93 points), and **Alex Tuch**, a week-9 pickup who was gone two weeks later.
**Vin** gets **Matthew Tkachuk**, Nick's 8th-round pick, who scored 61 for him.

story.headline: Three for three: Hall and Bobrovsky to Vin, Hellebuyck to Zac
body: The biggest trade of the season: **Vin** (8th, 2-3) and **Zac** (11th, 2-3) swap three players each in their fourth trade together.
**Vin** gets Zac's first-round pick **Taylor Hall** (53.6 before Vin moved on in February), 2nd-rounder **Sergei Bobrovsky** (162.2) and 15th-rounder **Ryan Ellis** (77.5).
**Zac** gets goalie **Connor Hellebuyck**, Vin's 4th-round pick (173.2), **Bryan Rust**, a week-5 pickup (128.6), and **James Neal** (27.7). 2019-20 ended without a champion.

story.headline: Jefe's third deal: Markstrom in, Pastrnak out
body: **Jefe** (4th, 9-5) makes his third trade of the season, a goalie for a star winger with **Danny** (2nd, 10-4). It's the eighth trade of 2018-19, the most in any season.
**Jefe** gets **Jacob Markstrom**, a week-10 pickup by Danny (and Zac's trade target a year earlier). He scored 65 for Jefe, who went on to win the title.
**Danny** gets **David Pastrnak**, Jefe's 4th-round pick, who scored 30.6 for him. Danny finished 3rd.

story.headline: Three days later, Palagi deals again: Krejci for Sissons
body: **Palagi** (6th, 7-6) is back three days after the Kopitar trade, this time with **Tom** (9th, 5-8).
**Tom** gets **Colton Sissons**, Palagi's 6th-round pick, who scored 39.3 for him. Tom finished 12th.

**Palagi** gets **David Krejci**, Tom's 13th-rounder and a Tom favorite (he drafted him in 2014-15, 2016-17 and 2017-18). Krejci never cracked Palagi's scoring lineup after the deal. Palagi finished 6th.

story.headline: Jefe lands Kopitar on the way to the title
body: **Jefe** (4th, 8-4) keeps building, trading with **Palagi** (6th, 6-6) for Palagi's first-round pick.
**Jefe** gets **Anze Kopitar** (76.9 after the trade), whom he'd also drafted in 2016-17, plus **Austin Watson**, a week-9 pickup (9.6). Jefe won the 2018-19 title.
**Palagi** gets **Ryan Nugent-Hopkins**, Jefe's 10th-rounder (64.8), and **Ian Cole**, a week-4 pickup and Jefe's 11th-rounder the year before (10.5). Palagi finished 6th.

story.headline: Josi, the sequel: Vin trades for him again
body: **Vin** (9th, 3-5) and **Zac** (2nd, 6-2) make their third trade, and a familiar name heads back to Vin.

**Vin** gets **Roman Josi**, Zac's 5th-round pick, whom Vin also traded for in January 2018 (and drafted in 2015-16). Josi scored 118 for Vin; **Mikael Granlund** added 1 before he was gone. Vin finished 7th.
**Zac** gets goalie **Mikko Koskinen** (30.6) and **Max Pacioretty** (0.1), both week-8 pickups by Vin. Zac finished 2nd.

story.headline: Danny's first trade: the first-place team adds Oshie
body: A day after Vin and Nick, **Danny** makes his first trade ever. He's 1st at 4-1; **Tom** (10th, 2-3) is making his second in 11 days.
**Danny** gets **T.J. Oshie**, Tom's 6th-round pick (Tom also had him in 2014-15 and 2016-17). Oshie scored 55.4 for Danny, who finished 3rd.
**Tom** gets **Brendan Gallagher**, Danny's 17th-rounder, who scored 66, and **Ryan Getzlaf**, Danny's 10th-rounder (23.4). Tom finished 12th.

story.headline: Ten days later, Vin deals again: Kane for Parise
body: Ten days after the Tom deal, **Vin** (11th, 1-4) calls **Nick** (2nd, 4-1) for their fourth trade together.
**Vin** gets **Evander Kane**, Nick's 3rd-round pick, who scored 146.7 for him. Vin climbed to 7th.
**Nick** gets **Zach Parise**, a week-2 pickup by Vin and Nick's own 16th-rounder the season before. Parise scored 36.8; Nick finished 5th.

story.headline: Tom's first trade: Trouba for Byfuglien
body: **Tom** makes his first trade ever, and of course it's with **Vin**. Both teams are 1-3 in week 5.
**Vin** gets **Dustin Byfuglien** again: Tom's 3rd-round pick, whom Vin had traded for the previous January. Big Buff scored 57 for Vin this time. Vin finished 7th.
**Tom** gets **Jacob Trouba**, Vin's 14th-rounder, who scored 135.5 for him, and goalie **Jack Campbell**, a week-4 pickup who was gone 12 days later. Tom finished 12th.

story.headline: Jefe's first trade, and a champion's run begins
body: Week 2, and **Jefe** makes his first trade ever. Both teams are 0-1. By March, Jefe would be the 2018-19 champion.
**Vin** gets **Blake Wheeler**, Jefe's 2nd-round pick, who scored 226.7 for him the rest of the way, plus **Erik Haula** (16th round), who never scored for Vin. Vin finished 7th.
**Jefe** gets **Micheal Ferland**, a week-1 pickup by Vin (119.9 points), and **Mathew Dumba**, Vin's 9th-rounder (61 before Jefe moved on at the end of December). Jefe won the title.

story.headline: Vin sends Draisaitl to Joe
body: The seventh and last trade of 2017-18, and **Vin**'s fifth of the season. Vin (1st, 14-2) sends his 2nd-round pick **Leon Draisaitl** to **Joe** (9th, 6-10).
**Vin** gets **Jaden Schwartz**, Joe's 15th-rounder, and **Ryan McDonagh** (9th round). They added -0.7 points in Vin's lineup the rest of the way; Vin still finished 2nd.
**Joe** gets **Draisaitl**, who scored 45.6 for him, and **Adam Larsson**, Vin's 5th-rounder. Joe finished 10th.

story.headline: Vin flips Keith after 20 days and lands Big Buff
body: **Vin**, 1st at 13-2, keeps dealing: his fourth trade of 2017-18. **Ronnie**, 11th at 5-10, is the partner.
**Ronnie** gets **Duncan Keith**, whom Vin got from Zac just 20 days earlier, and goalie **Carter Hutton**, a week-13 pickup. Hutton scored 46.6 for Ronnie and Keith 14.5. Ronnie finished 12th.
**Vin** gets **Dustin Byfuglien**, Ronnie's 5th-round pick (67.5 after the trade), and a 13th-rounder named **Sebastian Aho** (5.7). Vin finished 2nd.

story.headline: Palagi adds Montour on the road to a title
body: Four days after dealing with Zac, **Nick** (2nd, 10-4) is at it again, this time with **Palagi** (6th, 7-7). Nobody knew it yet, but Palagi was about to win it all.
**Palagi** gets **Brandon Montour**, a week-3 pickup by Nick, who scored 32 for him down the stretch. Palagi went on to win the 2017-18 championship.
**Nick** gets **Tyler Toffoli**, a week-9 pickup, and **Kevin Shattenkirk**, Palagi's 10th-rounder. Both were gone within three weeks, with -0.4 points combined. Nick finished 3rd.

story.headline: Zac's January spree continues: Markstrom for Jenner
body: **Zac** is making it a habit: his third trade in ten days. This time the partner is **Nick**, 2nd at 10-4.
**Zac** gets goalie **Jacob Markstrom**, a week-8 pickup by Nick, who put up 80.2 for him. Zac finished 8th.
**Nick** gets **Boone Jenner**, a week-12 pickup by Zac, who scored 18. Nick finished 3rd.

story.headline: Two days later, Vin and Zac go again
body: Two days after their first deal, **Vin** (1st, 11-2) and **Zac** (12th, 2-11) are back on the phone for a one-for-one of defensemen.
**Vin** gets **Roman Josi**, Zac's 4th-round pick and Vin's own 5th-rounder back in 2015-16. Josi scored 77.5 for Vin the rest of the way.
**Zac** gets **Zach Werenski**, a week-9 pickup by Vin, who scored 11.5 before Zac moved on from him in February.

story.headline: Zac's first deal: first place and last place swap two for two
body: **Zac** makes his first trade ever, and he goes straight to the top of the table: **Vin** is 1st at 11-1, Zac is 12th at 2-10.

**Vin** gets **Duncan Keith**, Zac's 8th-round pick, and **Henrik Zetterberg**, a week-11 pickup. Both were out of Vin's lineup within two weeks, with 14.7 points between them, and Keith was flipped to Ronnie before January was out.
**Zac** gets **Torey Krug**, who scored 86 for him, and **Calle Jarnkrok**, who was gone a week later. Both were Vin's week-12 pickups. Zac climbed from 12th to finish 8th.

story.headline: An all-Flyers swap: Couturier for Simmonds
body: Philadelphia for Philadelphia in week 6: **Vin** (1st, 4-1) and **Nick** (8th, 2-3) make their third trade together, the first of seven trades in a busy 2017-18.
**Vin** gets **Wayne Simmonds**, Nick's 2nd-round pick and a familiar face: Vin drafted him in 2014-15 and 2015-16. He scored 37.5 for Vin, who finished 2nd.
**Nick** gets **Sean Couturier**, a week-3 pickup by Vin, and hits it big: 167.4 points the rest of the way. Nick climbed all the way to 3rd.

story.headline: Sid the Kid moves at the deadline
body: A deadline blockbuster in week 19: **Sidney Crosby**, a first-round pick in every season of the league so far, changes hands. It's the first trade ever for both **Joe** (4th, 11-7) and **Palagi** (8th, 8-10).
**Joe** gets goalie **John Gibson**, Palagi's 4th-round pick, for the stretch run. Joe finished 6th.

**Palagi** gets **Crosby**, Joe's first-rounder (and Jefe's, Ronnie's and Steve's in the three seasons before). Neither player put up a point in his new team's lineup the rest of the way. Palagi finished 11th.

story.headline: New Year's Eve: first place deals with 0-10
body: Ringing in 2017 with a deal: **Vin**, 1st at 8-2, and **Nick**, still hunting his first win at 0-10, swap two for two in their second trade together.

**Vin** gets Nick's first-round pick **Patrice Bergeron**, a longtime Nick favorite (he drafted him in 2013-14 and 2014-15 too), plus **Cal Clutterbuck** (16th round), who was gone two weeks later. Bergeron scored 74.5 for Vin, who finished 2nd.
**Nick** gets **Milan Lucic**, Vin's 5th-rounder, and goalie **Steve Mason**, a week-5 pickup. Neither scored in Nick's lineup after the deal, but Nick still climbed out of the cellar to finish 9th.

story.headline: Vin's first trade lands a first-rounder: Getzlaf comes home
body: The first trade of 2015-16 is also the first of **Vin**'s career, the opening move of what becomes the league's busiest trading résumé. On the block: **Nick**'s first-round pick, **Ryan Getzlaf**.

**Vin** (5th, 8-5) gets **Getzlaf** back: Vin drafted him in 2013-14 and took him in round 1 in 2014-15. He scored 100.6 for Vin the rest of the way. **Andrei Markov**, Nick's 10th-rounder, lasted 12 days. Vin finished 4th.
**Nick** (8th, 5-8) takes **Dion Phaneuf**, Vin's 16th-round pick (53.5 after the trade), and **Mike Hoffman**, a week-8 pickup (19.5). Nick finished 10th.

story.headline: Trade No. 1: Ronnie and Nick open the books
body: Every trade history starts somewhere, and in this league it starts in week 5 of the very first season. **Ronnie** (8th, 2-2) and **Nick** (9th, 1-3) swap two for two, the first deal the RRDJ ever saw.

**Ronnie** gets **Bryan Little**, Nick's 15th-round pick, and **Matt Niskanen**, a week-1 pickup. Both delivered: Little scored 161.5 and Niskanen 139 for Ronnie after the trade, and Ronnie climbed to a 5th-place finish.
**Nick** lands goalie **Semyon Varlamov**, Ronnie's 15th-rounder, who put up 150 for him, plus **Mason Raymond**, another week-1 add who never cracked Nick's scoring lineup. Nick finished 7th.
